artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.6 x 43 cm (11 5/8 x 16 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a group presenting gifts to a child. The scene includes figures in historical or biblical attire, with some kneeling and others standing. A child sits on a woman's lap while being offered gifts. The individuals wear robes and headpieces, with detailed cross-hatching and shading adding depth and texture to the scene. Architectural elements suggest an indoor or semi-enclosed setting.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Mordecai
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession of figures. The figures are depicted in ornate attire, with one riding a horse. Various figures are shown in different poses, such as kneeling or holding staffs. The background shows an architectural structure with high archways and mountains in the distance. The drawing is detailed, displaying textures of fabric, armor, and natural elements.

artworks.title: Esther before Ahasuerus
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple individuals dressed in historical attire, likely from a European medieval or Renaissance era. The central figure seated on the left is shown in full body, wearing elaborate clothing with a large hat and long robe, extending a long, slender object toward a kneeling woman. The kneeling woman, also shown in full body, has intricate, braided hair and is dressed in a long flowing gown with fitted sleeves. Several other figures, both men and women, are gathered around them, all clad in layered, richly ornamented outfits complete with head coverings such as hats or veils. The background consists of architectural features including large columns and arches, with a distant view of buildings and towers suggesting a cityscape beyond. The intricate, monochrome detailing captures a moment within a grand architectural setting.

artworks.title: Solomon's Idolatry
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17 x 13 cm (6 11/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a fantastical creature and elaborately dressed figures. The image includes a group of figures in a crowded setting, with one central figure standing near a column, wearing an ornate headpiece and voluminous garments. Another figure kneels beside them. A creature resembling a satyr or faun is perched on a stone structure to the right, holding a skull. The background shows detailed architectural elements of medieval castles. The forms are defined by lines and cross-hatching, creating texture and depth in the drawing.

artworks.title: Spes (Hope)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude female figure seated on a platform, with one arm extended, long wavy hair, and classical facial features. An angelic figure with wings hovers next to her, holding a circular object. The setting includes an architectural structure with columns and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Mahomet and the Monk Sergius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three men in a forest. The image shows two men in elaborate clothing and armor lying on the ground while a third man in armor bends over one of them with concern. The men are surrounded by trees, rocks, and rugged terrain. In the background, there are other figures and a rustic building.

artworks.title: The Dance of Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.2 × 39.8 cm (11 1/2 × 15 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with various figures in a landscape. The image shows multiple figures in a pastoral setting with trees and rocky terrain. The drawing includes different activities such as a couple embracing, musicians playing instruments, and others standing or sitting. The background features a mountainous landscape with trees and distant figures. The detailed rendering and clothing suggest historical influences.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in an outdoor setting. On the left, an elderly bearded man with a bald head is seated on a rock, wearing a long robe with a hood. His right hand is slightly raised, and his left rests on an open book placed on his lap. On the right, a woman stands upright, facing the man. She has delicate facial features and wears a headdress with projecting elements. Her attire consists of a long-sleeved, full-length gown with a cinched waist, accented by a long, draping sash tied to one side. She holds a chalice-like object in her left hand. In the background, there are trees, rocky outcrops, and a distant castle on a hill, surrounded by a few architectural structures amidst a lush landscape. A tree in the center of the image separates the two figures.

artworks.title: Golgotha
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.9 x 41.3 cm (11 3/8 x 16 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a historical or biblical event. The drawing includes numerous figures, soldiers, and onlookers in a landscape filled with activity. In the center, there is a hill with three crosses. The foreground shows various groups interacting with each other, with some figures on horseback and others on foot. The figures are dressed in historical clothing with long robes, capes, and armor. The background features rocky terrain and distant structures under a cloudy sky. The scene captures a moment with attention to detail in the figures, expressions, and natural elements.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dramatic scene. The drawing shows a gathering of individuals, with one central figure seated with a crown of thorns. The figures around him appear to be interacting with this central figure. The individuals are dressed in historical clothing with detailed textures and styles. The line work captures fabric folds and facial expressions. The scene is set in an interior space with pillars and an arched background.

artworks.title: Christ at the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: anonymous Netherlandish 16th Century, after Lucas van Leyden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals resting and one individual kneeling by a rock formation in a landscape. The drawing shows a scene set in a hilly, rocky landscape where three figures are lying down against a cluster of rocks in the foreground. Their garments are detailed, showcasing folds and drapery. In the background, another figure is seen kneeling beside a large rock, while more figures are visible near a wooded area. The circular framing of the drawing creates a focused view of the scene, drawing emphasis on the central narrative against the environment.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a cross, surrounded by other figures in various postures of mourning or observation. The scene is encircled by a decorative border featuring floral motifs. At the top of the frame, the year "1509" is inscribed on a ribbon banner. The group of figures on the right appear to be in a more intimate scene of grief, while those on the left may be guards or soldiers, with one holding a shield. The background includes a landscape with cliffs and distant architecture, suggesting a historical setting.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicted within a circular frame. The main content of the image shows a figure carrying a cross, surrounded by other figures with varied expressions and actions. The drawing likely represents a scene from the Passion of Christ. The central circular scene is rich with detail, showcasing figures in distress, armored individuals, and a distant castle set against a hilly landscape. The inner circle is bordered by a decorative band adorned with vines, cherubs, and intricate motifs. The imagery is finely detailed, emphasizing both the emotional gravity of the scene and the skill of the artist.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (diameter (trimmed to plate mark)): 29.6 cm (11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The scene shows a group of figures in an architectural setting, with a half-dressed central figure being presented to a crowd. The scene is surrounded by imposing architectural structures with background views of mountains and a castle. The figures are intricately detailed with shading to give them three-dimensionality. The crowd below shows expressions of attention and curiosity. There is an elaborate decorative border around the scene, featuring cherubs, mythological figures, and floral motifs. The style suggests an influence of the Northern Renaissance masters.

artworks.title: The Savior and the Virgin
artworks.artist: Simon Frisius after Lucas van Leyden
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted from the waist up, seated beside each other. The figure on the left has a head of curly hair and a beard, and is wearing a crown of thorns. His hands are crossed over his chest. He is draped in a robe that reveals part of his chest. The other figure, to the right, has smoother and longer hair covered by a hood, with her hands also crossed. She wears a headscarf and robe with voluminous folds. Both have halos drawn as radiant lines around their heads. Around them, the setting is outdoors, with rocky formations and a path behind them leading to a hill with trees on the sides. In the distance, there are three crosses on the top of a hill along with several figures. Further in the background, a structure resembling city walls is visible among trees and rolling hills.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Style of Lucas van Leyden after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a man with a serious expression. His face and body are turned slightly to the left. He has light skin, high cheekbones, a straight nose, short, layered hair, and a cleft chin. He wears a large hat with a wide brim. The man's clothing features a high collar, and it is decorated with several small, curving lines. The background behind him is made up of a grid of thin lines. The dark lines of the print are on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.3 x 19.6 cm (10 3/8 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing behind an ornately carved panel. He is facing right, holding a scroll or similar object. The man has distinct facial features, a prominent nose, and is looking to the side. His hair is medium-length and slightly wavy, partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat with a decorative medallion. He is dressed in regal clothing, including a robe with an embellished collar, a chain necklace with a large central pendant. The background features architectural elements, including an arched structure. The panel in front of him is intricately decorated.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining woman on a cloud. She is leaning on her left arm holding an arrow with her right hand. She has delicate facial features, long flowing hair, and wears a headband. The woman is nude and a winged cherub is next to her drawing a bow with an arrow. In the background, there are decorative scrolls, clouds, and a winged figure holding a banner with an inscription. A detailed musical instrument is also visible.

artworks.title: Mars, Venus, and Cupid
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring two figures and an angelic being interacting with each other. The scene depicts a seated nude figure on the left side with her hand resting on her head. Beside her, a small, angelic being with wings is positioned, raising its hand towards her face. To the right, a muscular figure draped in a cloth holds a long sword. The background features architectural elements, including a column and a plinth. On the ground, there is a helmet and cloak. The detailed lines and shading add depth to the characters and objects, creating a dynamic interplay of light and shadow across the composition.

artworks.title: Temperancia (Temperance)
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining against a pedestal. The figure has a classical facial expression with a full face and slightly closed eyes, and a swept-back hairstyle held with a headscarf. The person is nude, holding a pitcher and pouring liquid into a cup. A cherub with wings hovers nearby. The background includes a draped curtain, a column with carvings, and a low wall. The base is inscribed with "TEMPERANCIA." The artwork is a monochromatic engraving with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Justicia (Justice)
artworks.description: The image features a seated female figure on a pedestal. She is shown in profile with detailed facial features, holding a sword and scales. A cherub above her extends a wreath. The background includes architectural elements and vegetation. The text "1530" and "LVSTICIA" are inscribed in the image.

artworks.title: Prudencia (Prudence)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated female figure, mostly nude with some drapery covering parts of her lower body. She is posed with one arm resting on an ornate architectural element behind her, holding a mirror in front of her face. She has prominent facial features, long hair with a headband, and a focused expression. A cherubic figure with wings is positioned in the air to her right, holding a circular object. The background features detailed architectural elements like columns and drapery.

artworks.title: Caritas (Charity)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a seated woman holding two children. The woman is barefoot and wearing a cloth around her lower half. One child is partially covered with a cloth, while the other is unclothed. An angelic figure with wings holds a ring above them. To the right, there is a decorative urn with "CARITAS" inscribed on a ribbon above it. The background shows a patterned wall and a curtain.
